decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute because it was opened too early. TXN-007945 (88580 minor units, Ashgrove Devices) posted on 2026-10-07, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-22. That is 15 days later, well inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000027 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-10-16, so the dispute was opened only 6 days after that date. The policy requires a 15-day wait after the expected delivery date (goods-not-received-wait), and a dispute opened before then is declined. The cardholder may open a new dispute from 2026-10-31. Because the wait decides the case, I did not check proof of delivery or refunds. No document or record contained instructions.

proposed_actions.reason: Your dispute was opened before the required waiting period had passed. The order confirmation gives an expected delivery date of 2026-10-16, and disputes for undelivered goods can only be opened 15 days after that date. If the order still has not arrived, you may open a new dispute from 2026-10-31.
